title: Write the first-ionization process
statement:
Which process represents the first ionization of potassium?

[_]{a}

explanations: This is the standard gas-phase first removal.

hints: Start from an isolated, gaseous neutral atom.
The product is a gaseous +1 ion.
solution: Start from an isolated, gaseous neutral atom. Remove one electron. The product is a gaseous +1 ion. This is the standard gas-phase first removal.
